candidates.description: This feature vector activates on anatomical terms, body parts, and medical terminology related to human organs and skeletal structures.
This vector represents common French words and morphemes featuring frequent sequences like 'pp', 'mp', and 'pt'.
This feature vector represents prefixes or roots of words related to biological, physiological, and artistic concepts.
This feature vector represents prefixes and roots of words related to continuation, duration, and conservation across multiple languages.
This vector represents African countries and related geographic or linguistic terms.
This vector is related to the linguistic sequence or phonetic unit 'ang' (and closely related variations).
This vector represents words related to frequency, prominence, and statistical prevalence across multiple languages.
This feature represents Italian and French preposition-article contractions and fused forms used for grammatical case and possession.
This vector represents common Italian nominal and adjectival suffixes or short rhyming word-endings.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing or related to the Latin root for life, activity, or derivation (such as *viv*, *tiv*, and *relativ*).
